# ADR-011 — Five tabs, Me, and three global tools

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Proposed |
| Date | 2026-11-22 |
| Cards | P3-006 |
| RTM ids | EP-§3.3-01, EP-§3.3-02, EP-§17.1-01, EP-§17-01 |
| Sources | `ELEVATION.md#§3.3:L790-L822`, `ELEVATION.md#§17:L2163-L2167`, `ELEVATION.md#§17.1:L2169-L2231` |

## Decision

The shell fixes five tabs (Today, Learn, Speak, Play, Village), Me top-left, and global Search, Lens, and Word Card. Search and Lens sit in the top bar. Word Card opens on a long-press of any target-language word, on every tab.

Every route keeps a home and the drawer is replaced only after the route map is 100% mapped. The replacement home for drawer entries is Me → All features. No route is cut to make the shell smaller.

Status is Proposed until Tope accepts.

## Surfaces

Homes below are the placement in §3.3 and §17.1. This ADR does not add a session length, a route count, or a mapping percentage.

| Surface | Place | What lives there |
|---|---|---|
| Today | Tab | One adaptive session: review, new input, speaking, a cultural moment, challenges, quests, events, streak |
| Learn | Tab | CEFR-aligned Path, lessons, Words & Review, Grammar, Listening, Writing, Tone Gym, Culture shelf, Passport, Downloads |
| Speak | Tab | Polie with all tutor modes, Scenarios, Historical Personas and Missions, Shadowing, Code-Switch and Respect coaches |
| Play | Tab | The Arcade: every game on skill shelves, Traditional Games, Multiplayer. Games also surface inside Today and Path as practice |
| Village | Tab | Map, Circles, Square feed, Chats, Status, Clips, Radio, School, Elder Hut, Corrections, Create and Contribute |
| Me | Avatar, top left | Avatar, progress, achievements, leagues, family, Plus, settings, All features directory |
| Search | Global, top bar | Words (into Word Card), people, circles, lessons, games, features by name |
| Lens | Global, top-bar camera | Point & Say, Live Translate, Import Media |
| Word Card | Global, long-press | Meaning, audio, Tone Lens, examples, save, practise |

## Options considered

| Option | For | Against | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Five tabs, Me top-left, global Search, Lens, and Word Card | Matches §3.3 and §17.1. Every route keeps a home under a tab, Me, or a global tool | The drawer cannot move until the route map is 100% mapped | Shell cards place features; nothing is removed |
| Keep Home, Courses, AI, Social, and Profile, with the drawer as the feature index | Those entry points already exist (§17) | Features compete, and the learner is not told which one to use when | The spine in §3.2 stays missing |
| Drop routes that do not fit five tabs | A smaller shell | Breaks EP-§17-01: no feature is lost or cut | Routes lose a home |

## Consequences

P3-036 writes the route map. A route or drawer item without a home fails that check. P3-037 builds the five tabs, Me at the top left, and the global top bar against this decision. P3-048 replaces the drawer with Me → All features only after the route map is 100% mapped. Search, Lens, and Word Card stay global tools. They are not a sixth tab.

## Verification

A review of this file checks three facts: the status field is Proposed; the five tab names, Me top-left, and global Search, Lens, and Word Card are fixed; the no-cut rule states that every route keeps a home and the drawer is replaced only after the route map is 100% mapped. This file records no measured route count and no measured share of routes already mapped.
